purpose: Freeze exact market-research inputs so an experiment can be rerun against the same population, period, normalized candles, source anomalies, and chronological plan.

dataContract.finalPolicy: Only normalized candles with final=true may enter research calculations.
dataContract.malformedRowPolicy: Rows without an 8-digit trading date are quarantined before strict candle normalization. They are never repaired or used as candles. Per-symbol anomaly count/hash and full anomaly provenance are stored with the snapshot.

hashPolicy.perSymbolHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON array of candleFieldsForHash in candleOrdering
hashPolicy.sourceAnomalyHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON source-anomaly records; null when no anomalies exist
hashPolicy.populationHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of populationDefinition plus symbolsSorted
hashPolicy.datasetHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON containing snapshot identity fields, ordered perSymbol candle hashes, and source anomaly provenance
hashPolicy.chronologicalPlanHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of the resolved chronological plan
